set.body: Design and implement the adapter boundary from ScalaFIM neuroimaging data into multivar plans. Keep shared multivar free of Spark and image IO. Add ROI/sample-by-feature plan adapters for mvpa/dataset, serializable MultivarPlan and FitArtifact shapes, and a JVM-only execution design where Spark maps partitions/ROIs and broadcasts small fitted maps. Acceptance: module boundaries remain acyclic; plans are pure and inspectable; ROI/block execution can be interpreted locally first; Spark-specific types live only in a later JVM adapter.
set.title: Multivar neuroimaging boundary: MVPA, datasets, and Spark-ready plans
